hypotheses.title: 60-Day Institutional Put Skew Exhaustion on Cashflow Quality (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: While 30-day skew captures monthly retail hedging, the 60-day tenor captures structural quarterly institutional hedging overhang. Fading acute 60-day downside put skew spikes on high cashflow compounders targets institutional panic exhaustion under industry neutralization.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during systemic solvency shocks where elevated put demand precedes further collapse.

hypotheses.title: 90D vs 30D Term Structure Conditioned on Analyst Revision Momentum (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 337, the 90D-30D term structure achieved 8 PASS (Sharpe 1.52, Sub-universe 0.94, Self-corr 0.4395), but Fitness was 1.08. By replacing cashflow with rapid institutional consensus upgrades (analyst_revision_rank_derivative), we capture firms with upward revision momentum whose option volatility is underpriced, driving Fitness past 1.50.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms when inverted term structures correctly anticipate persistent corporate deterioration.

hypotheses.title: 90D vs 30D Term Structure with Cubic Conviction (option8 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Tests cubic power curvature (power 3) on the 8 PASS 90D-30D term structure. Steeper curvature expands conviction on the highest-confidence names while keeping turnover low via z-score clipping [-2.5, 2.5], directly targeting a Fitness boost from 1.08 to >= 1.50.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when high-conviction term structure inversions persist across broad sectors.
